final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM Orders AS o JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender), mean_count AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT g.gender, g.order_count, g.order_count - m.average_count FROM gender_counts AS g JOIN mean_count AS m ON m.average_count IS NOT NULL WHERE g.order_count > m.average_count
